title: Hot Cocoa Mix

adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 30.1. The price increased to $5.20 (+3.4% vs $5.03), and recent weeks show a consistent ramp: 27→29→32 units at the same price. The last two weeks at $5.20 saw 27 and 32 units, indicating a price-insensitive demand spike. No past promotion at this price level exists, and the noise-adjusted promotion lift is only x1.0. The classical model suggests no uplift, but recent sales show sustained above-baseline performance. Price increase alone is unlikely to cause a lift; the observed trend is likely due to seasonal ramp (fall start) already captured by the baseline. No named driver justifies a change. Median remains 30.1. Spreads unchanged.
